column6: Both worked examples check (K = 10^-8 for N = 10 and N = 10,000).
All four correct; they agree with K = mu, which the old Core Idea contradicted.
Core Idea said K = 2mu and K < 2mu at neutral/purified sites; corrected to K = mu and K < mu.
Explainer said diploid K = 2mu; replaced with haploid derivation (N mu x 1/N = mu) so both ploidies give K = mu.
CUU worked: 3 third-position changes keep Leu, 6 others change; 20/2S vs 10/S gives 1.
AUG->AUA = Met->Ile verified in standard code.
almost all amino acid changes are lethal overstated; changed to "harmful". Not fixed, noted: Q4 answer's reasoning about mutation at nonsynonymous sites raising dS is muddled.
An element that copies once per round goes 1-2-4-8 only holds if every copy copies; worked literally it gives 1-2-3-4. Reworded.
McClintock did not coin "jumping genes" (she used "controlling elements"); reworded. Noted, not fixed: Q3 explanation "TEs are a primary driver of regulatory evolution" is strong.
Deficits 0.18 and 0.02 both equal 2 x var(p) (0.09, 0.01); checks.
Pooling loses alleles is a weak but plausible belief (confusing heterozygosity with allelic diversity); kept.
